newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan issues June fuel oil import tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan issues June fuel oil import tender.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy two 0.5-percent 38,000-tonne cargoes of fuel oil for June delivery, a company official said on Friday.
CPC seeks to buy one low-pour cargo for delivery June 11-30 and one high-pour cargo for delivery June 1-30, both to Keelung Taichung or Shenao on a cost-and-freight basis (c-and-f).
The tender closes on May 7 and is valid for two days.

In its last fuel oil purchase, CPC bought one 0.5 percent low pour cargo at $123 per tonne c-and-f for May 16-30 delivery and in an earlier tender it bought a high pour cargo for May 12-31 delivery also at $123.
